signs.Aries: The astral energy of the day can have several different effects. In your case, if you are dating someone for the first time, then the romantic atmosphere will tend to bring out all of your secret fantasies. You will melt under sparkling candlelight and feel as though your partner is the most amazing person in the whole world. However, don't get too carried away; wait before you give your heart away completely.
signs.Taurus: There is an air of excitement about your romantic escapades today. Even though you may have known your partner for some time, you feel as though you have just met, and the evening is spread before you like some kind of inviting new adventure. Enjoy this wonderful scenario while it lasts and squeeze every ounce of romanticism out of it.
signs.Gemini: You very rarely take the straightforward path toward anything, preferring to meander back and forth in a zigzag fashion toward your goal. This goes for the object of your affection, as well. Thanks to the current astral configuration, this tendency is likely to be increased. You may adopt some extremely artful tactics to capture the heart of your loved one. You may even choose to personally act out some of their most secret fantasies.
signs.Cancer: You can use all of your subtle charms to impress that special person you have had in mind for so long. They will appreciate the care and attention you pay to your appearance and will love the way your clothes are worn to reflect the latest trend, yet still give that sexy, irresistible look. You will almost definitely succeed.
signs.Leo: Today you can put aside all your practical tendencies if you want to succeed in dating the person of your dreams. The planets are urging you to become less subtle in your approach to romance. You can forget the Cinderella act just for the moment, and instead dress to kill, a pleasure you very rarely allow yourself, as you dislike being the center of attention.
signs.Virgo: The planets are conspiring to make a delightful evening. That special person who seems to have all the romance, the subtle charm, the perfect dress sense, and the most wonderfully intimate style may well sweep you off your feet. Because this all seems too good to be true, it may be better to wait at least a few days before you lose your head altogether.
signs.Libra: You can employ all of the subtle skills at your disposal this evening. You will have the ability to look into another person's eyes and to know exactly how to melt their heart. This is fine if you genuinely care for this person, and really wish to make them happy, but is perhaps not such a good idea if you are merely out for a good time.
signs.Scorpio: As you sometimes have a problem with being subtle, you may not appreciate the energy of the day. But if you could be more low-key, it would help you to finally get that special date that all of your more obvious ways of showing your affection have so far failed to do. You need to appeal to your intended's secret hopes and fantasies. If you can do that, you just may succeed.
signs.Sagittarius: It may take some time for the message to sink in today, but hopefully if the stars are smiling on you, it will. Someone has been going to great pains to attract your attention, but you have so far failed to notice. Under today's magical auspices, you may just get the hint. And when you finally do, you will be over the moon!
signs.Capricorn: The planetary configuration weaves all kinds of magical spells today, especially in connection with your love life. You can rest assured that if there is anyone to whom you have felt at all attracted, then this is the time to move in for the kill. You will appear as the most tantalizing person around, and they will succumb to your charms like a lamb to the slaughter. Oh, have mercy!
signs.Aquarius: You can charm your loved one with an evening of spellbinding entertainment tonight. The astral configuration will shore up all the cracks in your relationship in such a way that, for a while at least, it seems to have regained all of its old magic and charm. Enjoy the feeling of being in love again while it lasts. Who knows - it very well might.
signs.Pisces: Love is very subtle, gentle, and romantic today. This is not your usual style, which tends to be more forthright and unmistakable in its expression. If you are looking for romance, don't come on too strongly; you need to project an aura of tantalizing mystery. And if you don't give away all your secrets at once, you will be in good position to score.
